src.label: Taiwan Ministry of Agriculture — Quarantine Requirements for the Importation of Dogs and Cats (English text, in force 29 February 2024)

head: Dogs and cats need a microchip, rabies shot and an import permit; most need a blood test or 97 days in quarantine.
lines: Every dog or cat needs a microchip and a rabies vaccination given when it is over 90 days old and within 30 days to one year before import. The importer applies for an import quarantine permit at the port of entry at least 20 days ahead.

Animals kept continuously in a rabies-free country or zone need only that, plus an original veterinary certificate from the exporting country's quarantine authority. Animals from other places must also pass a rabies antibody test of at least 0.5 IU/ml, with blood taken 90 days to one year before import.

Without a valid test, the animal can still enter but is held in post-entry quarantine for 97 days from a blood sample that passes. The quarantine can be waived if the test is valid and the permit was requested at least 120 days before entry. A dog or cat with no microchip, or whose papers do not match, can be returned, destroyed or sent to quarantine.
